title: Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple
tagline: Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple — Historic Baghmali Shiva Sanctorum & Vaishali Democracy Heritage

heroImage.alt: Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple - Ashokan Pillar in Vaishali

overview.short: Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple in Baghmali, Hajipur, is an ancient Shiva temple situated in the heart of historic Vaishali district, where the world’s first democratic republic was born in the 6th century BCE.
overview.description: Located in the Baghmali quarter of Hajipur in Vaishali district, Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple is a revered pilgrimage center known for its serene pond courtyards and powerful Shiva Lingam. It serves as the gateway to the world-famous Buddhist and Jain heritage circuit of Vaishali, including the Ashokan Lion Pillar, the Buddha Relic Stupa, and the birthplace of Lord Mahavira at Kundalpur.
features: Ashokan Lion Pillar & Ananda Stupa at Kolhua
overview.about: A serene spiritual sanctuary connecting ancient Shaivite worship with the world’s oldest democratic heritage and Buddhist relic stupas.

howToReach.roadNote: Located in Baghmali, Hajipur, just 18 km north of Patna across JP Ganga Setu / Gandhi Setu.

topPlaces.name: Lal Keshwar Mahadev Main Sanctum
topPlaces.description: Ancient stone temple housing the revered Lal Keshwar Shiva Lingam and holy pond.

image.alt: Lal Keshwar Mahadev Main Sanctum - Vishnupad Temple, Gaya

topPlaces.name: Kolhua Ashokan Pillar & Monkey Tank (Markata-Hrada)
topPlaces.description: Intact 3rd-century BCE Ashokan pillar with a grand seated lion capital beside the historic tank where monkeys offered honey to Buddha.

image.alt: Kolhua Ashokan Pillar & Monkey Tank (Markata-Hrada) - The Vishnupad Temple is located on the shore of the River Chandrab

topPlaces.name: Vaishali Buddha Relic Stupa Site
topPlaces.description: Excavated 5th-century BCE Lichchhavi mud stupa that contained one-eighth of Buddha’s holy ash relics.

image.alt: Vaishali Buddha Relic Stupa Site - Chandan Kumar Yadav State Spokesperson of  Janta Dal United Bihar with Chief Minister

topPlaces.name: Vishwa Shanti Stupa Vaishali (Peace Pagoda)
topPlaces.description: Towering white marble Peace Pagoda erected in 1996 by Nipponzan Myohoji on the bank of Abhishek Pushkarini lake.

image.alt: Vishwa Shanti Stupa Vaishali (Peace Pagoda) in Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Abhishek Pushkarini (Sacred Coronation Tank)
topPlaces.description: Historic sacred reservoir where the elected 7,707 Lichchhavi republican representatives were consecrated.

image.alt: Abhishek Pushkarini (Sacred Coronation Tank) in Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Kundalpur Mahavira Birthplace Memorial
topPlaces.description: Revered white marble Jain pilgrimage shrine commemorating the birth of 24th Tirthankar Lord Mahavira.

image.alt:
Kundalpur Mahavira Birthplace Memorial - 73 Sunrise near Kesariya.

Photograph from Kesariya, Bihar taken by Anandajoti.

topPlaces.name: Raja Vishal Ka Garh (Ancient Parliament Mound)
topPlaces.description: Huge excavated 1-kilometer earthen rampart representing the ancient assembly hall of the Lichchhavi Republic.

image.alt: Raja Vishal Ka Garh (Ancient Parliament Mound) in Lal Keshwar Shiv Temple, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Ramchaura Mandir (Footprints of Lord Rama)
topPlaces.description: Ancient temple preserving the stone footprint of Lord Rama on his journey to Janakpur.

image.alt: Ramchaura Mandir (Footprints of Lord Rama) - This photograph was taken in greater Kolkata.
